parole.testo: Inherited from Middle Russian нерпа (nerpa), first attested from the 2nd half of the 16th century. Borrowed from Finnic language, probably from Livvi ńоrрра, compare Karelian ńorppa, Ludian ńorp, Finnish norppa (“ringed seal”); ultimately possible from Proto-Samic *noarvē (“seal”), probable substrat
